title: XLSB edit publication retains the validated workbook parse and repairs resource relationship guards
code_state: cell-value workbook-structure callers, sparkline and cell-watch publication, and cell-value resource guards; focused tests and no harness changes
authority: change 0651 queue row 13, decisions and correctness trade-off in change 0652, with the single-parse seam established by change 0599 and the resource-guard finding recorded by change 0647
reason_codes: insert_candidate_cell and transfer_cell still called the 0599 retaining helper and then reparsed the same candidate workbook
sparkline and cell-watch package publication validated a candidate workbook but left the facade's derived fields on the pre-edit Workbook
styles and shared-string transfer returned early or skipped relationship creation when the resource part existed while its workbook relationship did not
correctness is preserved by staging, complete parse validation, and one final owner assignment; exact no-ops remain no-parse results

accepted_evidence.resource_guards: two focused tests pass: existing styles.bin without the styles relationship, and existing sharedStrings.bin without the shared-strings relationship
accepted_evidence.derived_refresh: sparkline and cell-watch facade publication tests pass and compare the post-publication Workbook debug projection with a fresh parse of its published OPC package
accepted_evidence.regression_suite: cargo test -p litchi-xlsb --lib: 575 tests; cargo test -p litchi-xlsb --tests: the same 575 library tests plus 144 integration tests, all passing
accepted_evidence.static_gates: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check -p litchi-xlsb -j2, and cargo clippy -p litchi-xlsb --all-targets -j2 -- -D warnings all pass

accepted_costs.retained_parse_api: two crate-private Applied outcomes and one parse-retaining function are added in each worksheet owner; the public cell-watch package wrapper keeps its signature and sparkline remains an internal workbook adapter
accepted_costs.relationship_probe: resource transfer inspects the workbook relationship before independently creating a missing part or missing relationship; malformed staged candidates still fail before owner publication
accepted_costs.measurement_deferred: no speed, allocation, RSS, or release measurement is claimed until 0674 supplies the apply_workbook_structure selector and paired evidence

known_gaps.harness_owner: tools/perf-baseline selectors and gates are owned by 0674 and were intentionally left untouched
known_gaps.opc_migration: 0661 is concurrently migrating lazy OPC APIs; this change uses existing ownership methods and must pass the coordinator's post-cherry-pick compile gate
known_gaps.no_timing: the packet proves correctness and removes the named duplicate parse statically, but does not quantify elapsed-time or allocation change
